Name: Cobbled Constructions (CP or AT)
Author: fiveTrillionElves
Description:
[left][u][b][size=5]Cobbled Constructions [/size][/b][/u][size=5]
[/size][size=3]This is a full set of farm buildings in a solarpunk style that is[size=3] fully configurable using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Conflict Menu[/url]﻿, and[/size] features masks for all recolorable buildings and seasonal overlays for all buildings.[/size][size=3] The SVE Premiums and Winery are included in the downloads section as an optional download for those who do not play with SVE, and should work identically to the main mod. There is also an [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿ version in the optional files section for those who prefer it to CP.

As always, let me know if you encounter any bugs or performance issues. I'm still relatively new to SDV modding, but I'll do my best to fix them![/size][/left]
[u][b][size=5]Installation [/size][/b][/u][size=5]
[/size][size=3]1. Install the latest [/size][size=3][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/size][size=3].
2. Install the latest [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
3. Extract the zipped files to your [b]\Stardew Valley\Mods[/b] folder.

All buildings are enabled by default, but can be toggled off using the GMCM
[/size]
[u][b][size=5]Credits [/size][/b][/u][size=5]
[/size][size=3]Core art done by me, but many props and furniture were taken from base game SDV and recolored. Shoutout to [url=https://upload.farm/1BnI7p]Jack[/url]﻿ and [url=https://upload.farm/1ASUrD]Caz [/url]for uploading their saves so I could use them for some screenshots. Screenshots use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor[/url] and it's 1.6 patch.[/size]

Downloads.Description: This file contains the premium buildings and winery added by SVE.
An Alternative Textures version of the Cobbled Constructions Set. Doesn't require the core Cobbled Constructions mod to work, but does require Alternative Textures (as you might expect).
